I can't schedule the daily 07:45 brief, so I replied to Ruth in the #strategic-random thread to say so. I have no scheduling tool here and only act when someone messages me. Nothing will post automatically tomorrow.

I gave her two options:
- **Ask me each morning:** she asks for "the Strategic pod brief" and I post it in #strategic-random.
- **Scheduled job:** an admin sets one up to trigger me at 07:45.

I also told her that the brief will leave out finance figures unless one was already posted in #strategic-random. It will also skip anything from #inc-vtg-hartford or #strategic-pod that Gideon and Nadia couldn't already see. Ruth is in all three channels, and everyone in #strategic-random is also in the other two.
